message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard is explicitly titled 'Midyear Months with Strong Response' and only displays data for May through September. There is no full-year data, no causal or ROI validation, and no stated approval threshold. The available option 'Hold and request full-year marketing analysis' directly addresses the limited scope of the evidence by requesting the missing full-year analysis, which is the appropriate follow-up for a budget request based on a midyear-only dashboard.", "option_label": "Select 'Hold and request full-year marketing analysis'"}
